entries.title: Psalms 109:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm.>> O God of my praise, be not silent:

entries.title: Psalms 109:2
segments: For the mouth of the wicked [man] and the mouth of deceit are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue,

entries.title: Psalms 109:3
segments: And with words of hatred have they encompassed me; and they fight against me without a cause.

entries.title: Psalms 109:4
segments: For my love they are mine adversaries; but I [give myself unto] prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 109:5
segments: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

entries.title: Psalms 109:6
segments: ¶Set a wicked [man] over him, and let [the] adversary stand at his right hand;

entries.title: Psalms 109:7
segments: When he shall be judged, let him go out guilty, and let his prayer become sin;

entries.title: Psalms 109:8
segments: Let his days be few, let another take his office;

entries.title: Psalms 109:9
segments: Let his sons be fatherless, and his wife a widow;

entries.title: Psalms 109:10
segments: Let his sons be vagabonds and beg, and let them seek [their bread] far from their desolate places;

entries.title: Psalms 109:11
segments: Let the usurer cast the net over all that he hath, and let strangers despoil his labour;

entries.title: Psalms 109:12
segments: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him, neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children;

entries.title: Psalms 109:13
segments: Let his posterity be cut off; in the generation following let their name be blotted out:

entries.title: Psalms 109:14
segments: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah, and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out;

entries.title: Psalms 109:15
segments: Let them be before Jehovah continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth:

entries.title: Psalms 109:16
segments: Because he remembered not to shew kindness, but persecuted the afflicted and needy man, and the broken in heart, to slay him.

entries.title: Psalms 109:17
segments: And he loved cursing; so let it come unto him. And he delighted not in blessing; and let it be far from him.

entries.title: Psalms 109:18
segments: And he clothed himself with cursing like his vestment; so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones;

entries.title: Psalms 109:19
segments: Let it be unto him as a garment with which he covereth himself, and for a girdle wherewith he is constantly girded.

entries.title: Psalms 109:20
segments: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 109:21
segments: ¶But do *thou* for me, Jehovah, Lord, for thy name's sake; because thy loving-kindness is good, deliver me:

entries.title: Psalms 109:22
segments: For I am afflicted and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

entries.title: Psalms 109:23
segments: I am gone like a shadow when it lengtheneth; I am tossed about like the locust;

entries.title: Psalms 109:24
segments: My knees are failing through fasting, and my flesh hath lost its fatness;

entries.title: Psalms 109:25
segments: And I am become a reproach unto them; [when] they look upon me they shake their heads.

entries.title: Psalms 109:26
segments: Help me, Jehovah my God; save me according to thy loving-kindness:

entries.title: Psalms 109:27
segments: That they may know that this is thy hand; that *thou*, Jehovah, hast done it.

entries.title: Psalms 109:28
segments: Let *them* curse, but bless *thou*; when they rise up, let them be ashamed, and let thy servant rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 109:29
segments: Let mine adversaries be clothed with confusion, and let them cover themselves with their shame as with a mantle.

entries.title: Psalms 109:30
segments: I will greatly celebrate Jehovah with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

entries.title: Psalms 109:31
segments: For he standeth at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those that judge his soul.
